objective: Close the provenance gap where the authoritative rainwater construction and single-authority contracts existed but were not members of the scene-metadata coverage source set used by the construction/material SHA-256 render binding.

changes.summary: Added rainwater_downpipe_installation_contract.json and rainwater_system_authority_contract.json to danchi_domain.contractPaths so QualityBlockConstructionMaterialEvidenceBindingQA includes both in the exact render-bound source bundle.

Versioned the rainwater single-authority contract to 1.1.0 and made exact-SHA evidence membership, post-capture mutation rejection, fresh-render requirement and zero automatic visual points machine-readable.

Added QualityBlockRainwaterEvidenceBindingQA. Formal QA4K, temporal and reflection pre-cull callbacks now fail closed if either required rainwater contract is not exactly once in danchi_domain, or if the authority evidence-binding policy is weakened. Render callbacks remain read-only.

reasoning.issue: The mature rainwater installation and new single-authority policy were validated at source/runtime level, but danchi_domain.contractPaths omitted both. Because the construction/material evidence binder derives its protected SHA-256 file set from those domain contract paths, a render receipt could previously be sealed without cryptographically including the rainwater-specific contracts.
reasoning.risk: That gap weakened the critical missing_required_construction_material_metadata guarantee for a benchmark-facing service assembly and could allow metadata-policy changes to escape the exact source bundle tied to rendered pixels.
reasoning.chosenAction: Bind existing mature rainwater reasoning into evidence provenance instead of adding another speculative geometry system. Add a narrow fail-closed membership QA rather than duplicating the existing rainwater construction implementation.

failureInjection: remove rainwater_downpipe_installation_contract.json from danchi_domain.contractPaths and confirm formal pre-cull rejects
remove rainwater_system_authority_contract.json from danchi_domain.contractPaths and confirm formal pre-cull rejects
duplicate either required rainwater contract path and confirm membership QA rejects
change rainwater authority evidenceBinding.domainId away from danchi_domain and confirm rejection
disable requireExactSha256WithRenderedScene, rejectPostCaptureContractMutation or freshUnityRenderRequiredAfterMutation and confirm rejection
seal a real render receipt, mutate either bound rainwater contract, and confirm construction/material evidence binding invalidates the candidate rather than reusing old pixels

expectedVisualScoreImpact.note: No category receives points until fresh 3840x2160 Unity renders and 100% crops are reviewed. The change prevents rainwater metadata provenance from being omitted or silently weakened.

nextBlocker: No Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner/workflow is available on the branch. When one appears, stop speculative expansion, compile first, execute the rainwater evidence-membership failure injections, then capture fresh frontal/oblique/grazing 3840x2160 frames plus rainwater 100% crops and temporal LOD evidence before scoring.
